_note: E5 observed values. Browser: headless Chromium (build 1194) via Playwright, real service worker, localhost same-origin receiver. Visibility/pagehide were dispatched SYNTHETICALLY (not real OS backgrounding), so landing rates are an UPPER BOUND on the sendBeacon delivery path, NOT the field rate. Compare to published field rates (~95.8% sendBeacon on unload-family events; ~82.9% for all four unload events) as expectations, not equivalents.

real_navigation.note: single-trial, inconclusive; a real cross-page navigation did not land a beacon within a 5s poll window in this harness — flagged for follow-up, not a field measurement

no_unload_listeners: asserted by tests/unit/e5-lifecycle.test.ts across harness/client.js, harness/sw.js, and the generated client
payload_64kib: chunked (chosen behaviour); a registry-sized bag (~40 counters) is <2KB, far under the 64KiB cap — see tests/unit/e5-lifecycle.test.ts
stand_ins: Synthetic visibility/pagehide events, not real OS backgrounding (iOS PWA backgrounding, ledger Q1, not reproducible here).

Storage eviction not induced: headless Chromium does not reproduce real iOS localStorage/IndexedDB eviction (ledger Q2). localStorage-vs-IndexedDB durability under eviction pressure could NOT be determined in this harness.
Beacon coalescing under rapid visibility flapping (ledger Q5) not isolated: synthetic dispatch landed 1:1, but this does not measure real browser coalescing.
